headline: India and Nepal Launch Cross-Border Passenger Railway Service
summary: Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Nepal Prime Minister Balendra Shah flagged off a passenger train connecting Ayodhya and Janakpur, expanding rail transit options between the neighboring countries.
why: Cross-border infrastructure projects enhance bilateral trade, tourism, and regional economic connectivity across South Asia.

impacts.name: India
impacts.why: Enhanced cross-border infrastructure facilitates regional trade and tourism flows.
